name: Google Cloud Storage (XML API, S3 interoperability)
tax_note: The Cloud Storage pricing page lists prices in USD and does not say whether tax is included. If you pay in another currency, the prices on Cloud Platform SKUs apply.

price.note: Pricing page, Data storage, location type Region, identical for Finland (europe-north1), Belgium (europe-west1) and Netherlands (europe-west4): $0.02 / 1 gibibyte month (also listed hourly). Billed per GiB, prorated to the sub-second.

put_per_1000.note: Pricing page, Operation charges, buckets located in a single region, flat namespace, per 1,000 operations. Class A $0.005; XML API PUT and POST are Class A.

get_per_1000.note: Pricing page, Operation charges, buckets located in a single region, flat namespace, per 1,000 operations. Class B $0.0004; XML API GET Object and HEAD are Class B.

list_per_1000.note: Pricing page, Operation charges, buckets located in a single region, flat namespace, per 1,000 operations. Class A $0.005; XML API GET Bucket when listing objects is Class A. Operations on a bucket are billed at the bucket's default storage class rate.

price_per_gb.note: Pricing page, Retrieval fees: Standard storage $0 / 1 gibibyte (the table lists $0 for Standard storage).

free_allowance_gb_per_month.note: No free internet egress for these regions: the Always Free tier's 100 GB data transfer is 'from North America', and Always Free quotas apply only to US-WEST1, US-CENTRAL1 and US-EAST1.

egress.free_allowance_scope: Always Free (US regions only) does not cover buckets in Europe.

price.note: Pricing page, General network usage, 'Data transfer to Worldwide Destinations (excluding Asia & Australia)', per GiB: 0 to 10 TiB $0.12 / 1 gibibyte per month per account. Bands converted to GiB (1 TiB = 1024 GiB).
Pricing page, General network usage, 'Data transfer to Worldwide Destinations (excluding Asia & Australia)', per GiB: 10 to 150 TiB $0.11.
Pricing page, General network usage, 'Data transfer to Worldwide Destinations (excluding Asia & Australia)', per GiB: 150 TiB and above $0.08.

notes: Asia destinations have the same bands; China ($0.23/$0.22/$0.20) and Australia ($0.19/$0.18/$0.15) cost more. Inbound transfer is free.
Transfer to other Google Cloud locations is priced per the within-Google-Cloud matrix (Europe to Europe $0.02/GiB) and is not modelled.

egress_fair_use.note: No fair-use rule for egress is stated on the pricing page; all internet egress is billed.

object_lock.note: Cloud Storage has Bucket Lock and Object Retention Lock (the XML API names the modes GOVERNANCE and COMPLIANCE, https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/object-lock), but no source checked says that S3 Object Lock calls or x-amz-object-lock headers work through the S3-compatible XML API.

free_tier.value: Always Free: 5 GB-months of Standard storage, 5,000 Class A and 50,000 Class B operations, and 100 GB data transfer from North America per month; only in US-WEST1, US-CENTRAL1 and US-EAST1 (aggregated).
free_tier.note: Does not apply to the European regions in this profile. Subject to change; eligibility per the Google Cloud Free Tier FAQ.

s3_endpoints.note: One global XML API endpoint; use HMAC keys. For V4 signing 'you can use any value for LOCATION', the bucket's location is recommended (https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/authentication/signatures). Both virtual-hosted (BUCKET.storage.googleapis.com) and path-style are documented without a preference; domain-named (dotted) buckets need path style (https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/request-endpoints).

notes: Prices are USD list prices for buckets in a single region (location type Region); dual-region and multi-region buckets cost more and are not modelled.

The pricing page renders its regional price tables from data embedded in the page; values were read from that data on 2026-10-13 for europe-north1, europe-west1 and europe-west4 (all identical). Other EU regions (for example europe-west3 Frankfurt, Standard $0.023) differ and are not modelled.
Prices are per GiB (the page says 'gibibyte').
